column1: # Which dictionary modules may print on which form, and which denominator each form belongs to
#. Declared by hand; nothing infers it.
# kind: `render` — a module computes the form's lines (it is, or is owed, a render gate in

#       W-2 and 1099-R; whether this repo does is a product decision, so these fields are reported
#       in their own class, never banked as "never rendered"); `no-module` — nothing in the
#       dictionary computes its lines yet, so any mapping on it beyond identity is suspect.
# modules: the `module` values (facts-manifest.json) whose facts may be mapped on the form. The `*`
#       row is the identity set allowed everywhere (name/SSN header boxes). A fact from any other
#       module fails --audit — that is how a form4797 fact printed in Form 4684's "$100" box, a
#       Form 6251 fact printed as Schedule D line 13, and rental-only §179 facts printed as Form
